status: Prospective scoring set; no scored comparison dispatched. Pilot is excluded regardless of outcome.
selected_by: Operator, from existing key definitions before reading the pilot report; not an independent grading judgment.
rule: Measure ordinary functional-contract recall. Exclude focused memory-safety, privilege/containment and resource-exhaustion investigations from that measure. Incidental findings outside this denominator may be reported without security investigation and must not be silently counted as key misses.
limits: The task and denominator differ from the original audit study. Eligibility is not a claim that included bugs lack possible security implications. Only bounded functional evidence is requested. Ambiguous matches remain unresolved until independent grading; no post-output key selection.
